window.title: New Customer!
window.info: This cutie pie waits patiently in line and doesn’t ask much. The best kind of customer!

window.title: New Customer!
window.info: Nothing beats seeing a cheerful, smiling boy queuing patiently at our restaurant!

window.title: New Customer!
window.info: Business men have hectic schedules, so you can expect them to pay more for fast service.

window.title: New Customer!
window.info: These career ladies are willing to wait in line a bit longer, but will tip less.

window.title: New Customer!
window.info: He is half-way to becoming world famous, hence his cocky attitude. He pays good money though, so we should serve him with a smile.

window.title: Special Customer!
window.info: International famous food critic! His reviews are usually harsh and he can really make or break a business. Loved by foodies, dreaded by restaurant managers.

window.title: New Customer!
window.info: Old, tired and full of interesting war stories. Listen to his stories as you serve him and you might get a generous tip.

window.title: New Customer!
window.info: Fairly patient and always in a good mood. Love her and she will love you back by giving you a generous tip.

window.title: New Customer!
window.info: Had training all her life to keep smiling no matter what happens, including when she has to queue very long. Does not tips as good, though.

window.title: New Customer!
window.info: A very famous figure back in his country, so he gets impatient when being told to queue. Will tip pretty good.

window.title: New Customer!
window.info: Has full schedule throughout each week, does not want to wait for long. Tips fairly good.

window.title: New Customer!
window.info: Made big money by chasing bad guys in action movies, he’ll tip very good if treated exceptionally well.

window.title: New Customer!
window.info: Being one of the richest people in the world does pay! She’ll leave if not treated well, but will tip lots when her high standards are met.
